body.x: HEALINGSOUND Co., Ltd. (CEO Jungu Kang) announced that it will exhibit at CES 2025, which will be held from January 7th (Tuesday) to January 10th (Friday) in Las Vegas, USA, under the "K-Startup Pavilion."

HEALINGSOUND is dedicated to developing healthcare solutions using ICT technologies, focusing on medical software and hardware development. Established in 2017 by experts in medicine, IT, and medical services, the company aims to create digital therapeutics that benefit patients and medical professionals. Previously, HEALINGSOUND gained industry attention with its product 'HealingStone,' which helps reduce dental phobia and protect patients' hearing.

The company continues to develop, enhance, and expand digital therapeutics, striving to contribute to healthcare infrastructure worldwide and to grow into a unicorn company that innovates medical practices globally.

HEALINGSOUND will present its portable infrared device, ‘EarNap,’ to achieve its global goals at CES 2025, the world's largest IT and technology exhibition. EarNap is designed to alleviate ear fatigue and treat ear conditions.

EarNap is shaped like wired earbuds designed to function as a medical device. It addresses otitis externa, which can lead to complications like otitis media or hearing loss, by inserting the device into the ear and using infrared LED light on the affected area. The LED module is positioned close to the inflammation to maximize treatment effectiveness.

Compared to similar hospital-use devices, EarNap offers superior convenience and safety. While traditional equipment often emits high temperatures of 50–60°C during treatment, posing a burn risk, EarNap employs nanochip technology to keep the temperature below 39°C while providing easy wearability. The device allows users to adjust LED intensity and time limits and supports functions like pausing and resuming during operation.

A HEALINGSOUND representative stated, “HEALINGSOUND has built a strong reputation as a trusted provider of medical devices and software, supplying various solutions to major domestic and international medical institutions, including Yonsei University Severance Hospital. EarNap is a standout product, recognized for enabling individuals to manage their ear health easily anytime, anywhere.”

The representative added, “We are delighted to showcase our products and technologies at CES 2025, which attracts global tech industry stakeholders and many experts in the medical field. Through this event, we aim to actively promote our brand to the global market, discover new buyers, and achieve our goal of becoming a leading global company in advanced medical technology.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
